checks.text: The page shows the heading "Reaction Time Test", the button "Start trial", and the text "Ready to start".
Clicking the button "Start trial" changes the main display to "Wait for green..." and disables the "Start trial" button.
After the wait phase completes (simulated by a fixed 1000ms delay for testing), the main display changes to "Click now!" and the "Start trial" button remains disabled.

Clicking the main display area while it shows "Click now!" records a reaction time. If the user clicks exactly 250ms after the green state appears, the display shows "250 ms" and a new row is added to the table labelled "History" with the value "250".
After recording a reaction time of 250 ms, the button "Start trial" becomes enabled again and the main display shows "Ready to start".
Clicking the tab labelled "Stats" shows a table labelled "All results" with columns "Time (ms)" and "Date". The row added in A4 appears with "250" in the "Time (ms)" column.
In the "Stats" tab, clicking the button "Copy best" copies the text "Best: 250 ms" to the clipboard and shows the toast "Copied to clipboard".
In the "Stats" tab, clicking the button "Clear history" removes all rows from the table labelled "All results" and shows the text "No results yet".
Reload keeps the history: after recording a reaction time of 250 ms and reloading the page, the "Stats" tab still shows a row with "250" in the "Time (ms)" column.
